description:
The Shimano 7-speed Derailleur

Made by durable aluminum alloy material, the 7 speed gear shift allows for more torque options. Using this system accurately can increase the range of a single charge by up to 14%.You can ride easily, smoothly, and efficiently.

LCD Multifunction Display

The display provides you with a variety of information to monitor your riding necessities. to help you keep track of your riding conditions. A charge indicator, a speedometer, an odometer, a trip odometer, a pedal assist level, and more features.

Tough 26"*4.0" Fat Tires

The tough fat tires are laced to wide rims and even wider hubs, making them stiff and enhancing the tires' grip. The fat tires guarantee your safety and offer you an easy and smooth riding experience.

Adjustable Suspension Fork

A high-performance, shock-absorbing, front suspension fork can take your original riding comfort to the next level. In addition, the fork has a lockout lever to allow for quick adjustments while riding to stiffen or soften the fork, depending on weight and riding style.

Mechanical Disc Brakes

The front and rear 180 mm disc rotors give sufficient braking force even in the roughest of conditions.

Ergonomic Half Twist Throttle

The Half-twist throttle helps prevent accidental activation, protecting you from inadvertent injuries. Gently twist the throttle on your right to accelerate.

48V LED Headlight

Using the bright headlight with a unique LED circle, you'll always be seen even in the dark of night. Visibility is improved to guarantee your safety while riding at night.

Extra Large Cushioned Saddle

This bike seat is a wide and adjustable ergonomically comfortable and durable seat with generous padding to reduce the impact of road bumps. Avoid possible hip and back problems, and give you the best riding experience.

Front and Rear Full Fender

A Well protected fender means a well protected tire. Prevents sand, water, and pebbles from harming your wheels.

Sensitive cadence sensor

Aluminum crankset guards provide protection to the chainring and excellent power transfer with efficiency. Strong, light, durable, high axial strength and compatibility.

Large-payload Rear Rack

The sturdy structure allows you carry heavy cargo. Attach panniers, platforms, or baskets and let the bike carry your cargo. Storing of your belongings is easy thanks to the extra space.

Kickstand

The double-leg kickstand offers increased balance when your bike is parked, allowing for more weight to rest on your bicycle without it tipping it over.
